placeholders.patternsNote: Live 2026-10-30, Claude Code 2.1.314 on herdr-core: the empty box rotates faint hints (`Try "refactor <filepath>"`, `Try "fix lint errors"`, `Try "how do I log an error?"`). herdr-core reads the screen as plain text, so the faint attribute is gone and the hint read as a draft; a walky talky delivery stayed held as draft present. The shape counts only on a read with no styling at all; on a styled read the faint attribute decides, so a typed `Try "…"` stays a draft. Fixture surface/claude--v2-1-314-placeholder-plain--w120 (plain text, as herdr-core reads it).
placeholders.anyTextNote: M78 spec 06, 2026-10-30: after a turn the empty box shows a faint prompt suggestion in free words (`cat hello.txt to verify`, `fix it`, `save it to docs/terminal-history.md`). No text, prefix or pattern names it; on herdr-core the faint attribute is gone and the suggestion read as a draft, so a send was refused draft_present. On a read with no styling the Send Protocol proves such a box by its probe: a suggestion is not in the input, so the probe character lands at the start of the box. Fixtures claude--done, claude--ghost-suggestion and the claude-lab--statusline-* set, stripped of SGR.

below.hintsNote: Live check 2026-10-30, Claude Code 2.1.312 over tmux, 120 columns: a fresh pane draws `You've used 75% of your weekly limit · resets Nov 4, 2am (…) · /usage-credits to keep using Claude Code` under the footer, and drops it once the box grows to two rows. The rows under the box went from 2 to 1 and the send ended typed_not_submitted (changed). The pattern covers any percentage and any limit name (`weekly`, `5-hour`, `Opus weekly`); the tail after `limit` is free. Fixture claude--v2312-weekly-limit-row--w120.

paste.imageNote: Lab 2026-10-21, Claude Code 2.1.305 over herdr: a whole-text paste loses each piece (cut at a newline, and at a space before an absolute path) that is an existing .png/.jpg/.jpeg/.gif/.webp file at an absolute path, any case; each shows as `[Image #N]` before the rest, and the kept pieces are joined by newlines. A missing file, a .txt, a file without extension, a `~/` or a relative path, and a path with words after it stay text. Lab 2026-10-30, Claude Code 2.1.312 over tmux: the path is attached only when it is the WHOLE paste (`[Image #1]`); a path among other text stays text, cut onto a row of its own after the space, and a fold counts every typed line break (42 lines with a path: `+41 lines`; one 900-character line with the path: `[Pasted text #1]`). The compare takes both forms (`WholePaste.literal`), after the field case of 2026-10-29 where a two-paragraph message with the path was typed and never submitted.
paste.blockNote: Lab 2026-10-20, Claude Code 2.1.304 over herdr: one bracketed paste of the whole text folds to `[Pasted text #N +M lines]`, M the line breaks (60 lines: +59; 30 short lines: +29); 3 short lines land literally; a 700-word line folds to `[Pasted text #N]`.
